title: Rubric-Based Assessment of Student Reports Using Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.01785v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language models can analyze and assess student texts using predefined rubrics and deliver structured feedback, reducing instructors' workload. However, existing solutions often rely on external services that are resource-intensive, costly, and raise privacy concerns, making them unsuitable for constrained environments. This study evaluates an automated assessment pipeline with three key aims: design for low-resource environments, privacy, and focus on a novel context in cybersecurity education. The pipeline integrates lightweight language models for textual evaluation and a vision-language model for image interpretation. Responses from 105 students were collected over two semesters of an undergraduate course during a cybersecurity exercise on incident response. Results across different hardware configurations show that small models in low-resource environments can achieve up to 97% accuracy in text-only and up to 94% in rich-text asses

translated_title: 使用小型语言模型进行基于量规的学生报告评估
translated_abstract: 语言模型可以利用预定义的量规来分析和评估学生文本并提供结构化反馈，从而减轻教师的工作负担。然而，现有解决方案通常依赖于资源消耗大、成本高昂且存在隐私隐患的外部服务，因此不适用于资源受限的环境。本研究评估了一个自动化评估流水线，其具有三个关键目标：面向低资源环境的设计、隐私保护，以及聚焦于网络安全教育中的新场景。该流水线集成了用于文本评估的轻量级语言模型和用于图像解读的视觉-语言模型。研究在某本科课程为期两个学期的网络安全事件响应演习中收集了105名学生的作答。在不同硬件配置下的实验结果表明，低资源环境中的小型模型在纯文本评估中可达到高达97%的准确率，在富文本评估中可达到高达94%的准确率。
tldr: 该研究提出一个面向低资源环境且保护隐私的自动化评估流水线，利用小型语言模型和视觉-语言模型依据量规评估学生在网络安全事件响应演习中的报告，纯文本评估准确率最高可达97%。
en_tdlr: This study presents a privacy-preserving, low-resource automated assessment pipeline that uses small language models and a vision-language model to grade student cybersecurity incident response reports against rubrics, achieving up to 97% accuracy for text-only evaluation.
